notes.title: My new game CUCCCHI is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YQH36NKnRxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[ Steam page link! ]

CUCCCHI is a game I've been working on since the release of Promesa.

It was made on commission for Fantastico Studio and the Enzo Cucchi Archive, who asked me to create a videogame inspired by the imaginary of italian painter Enzo Cucchi.

The nature of this project is completely different from Promesa, and while it's pretty crazy visually, it also has more traditional game elements in it.

Check the steam page to find out more!

notes.title: Promesa is coming to consoles!
notes.content:
Game update:

I have added 3 different walk speed options, which means that now it's possible to play Promesa with a slightly faster pace.
I think that the walk speed in Promesa sets a tone and a flow for the experience, but since the slow pace can be too much for some, I decided to enable some flexibility.

With this update also comes a french translation! Thanks to Martina Dell'Utri, Catalina Pita Fort and Gaia Scandella for taking care of it.

Promesa is coming to consoles!

Thanks fo Fantastico Studio, Promesa is now available on Xbox and will be available on Playstation and Nintendo Switch on June 25th!

notes.title: Promesa available in Russian! + Milan Games Week
notes.content:
Promesa is now available in Russian!

I'm happy to announce that thanks to Анастасия Мякинина and Сергей Николаев, Promesa got a new full translation.
For any Russian players, please let me know if it all works fine, and help me spread the word :)

Milan Games Week

The other news is that Promesa is part of the indie selection at the Milan Games Week!
The demo will be available again during the event, which ends on November 29.
You can know more about the event here: www.milangamesweek.it

The Steam Awards 

Other than that, I saw one reviewer that went on to nominate Promesa for the "Outstanding Visual Style" award (thank you!).
If you feel Promesa deserves a shot, go on and nominate it!

notes.title: Steam achievements and Promesa exhibited at Midbo 22
notes.content:
Steam Achievements

I'm implementing a small number of Steam Achievements: pop-ups for these will appear only in the main menu or in the pause menu, so to not interrupt the flow of the experience.

Most of the achievements are going to be quite basic (playing levels and going through all of them), but some of them are going to be more interesting.

You can already see the list of achievements in the game page, but they are not implemented yet.
I'm working on them now and they should be ready in a couple of days.

Hope you'll enjoy them!

Promesa at Midbo 22

Promesa is being exhibited at the Midbo 22 (the 22nd edition of the international documentary exhibition of Bogotà), in the expanded documentary category, alongside other latin-american and international artists and works.

You can see the expanded documentary section here:
http://suenosdistantes.midbo.co/

And the rest of the exhibition here:
https://www.midbo.co/

notes.title: Bug fixing and small price update for some regions
notes.content:
Bug Fixing

Today I uploaded a new mac build to match the windows one that was already up to date.

- Fixed weird colliders issues in a scene
- Fixed ortographic errors in the spanish texts (ːsteamfacepalmː)
- Fixed minor sound bugs
- And other minor things here and there.

Thanks to those who reported me bugs privately and in the community.

Small price update in some regions

In the near future (depending on Valve approval) there'll be a price update for some regions:
it'll be a small update and the game will stay very cheap (under 5€ - and even way below that).

You can see a list of every current region price here: https://steamdb.info/app/1345370/

Valve automatically sets the price for every region, but I'll ask to manually change the prices as in some regions the game is on sale for less than half of the intended price.

You'll still be able to get the game for the current price in the next days.

Thank you, and I'm sure you'll understand.
